question: Should OpenClaw add a core runtime-enforced immutable operator policy overlay for config, tool, and system defaults, or keep immutable baseline checks in the conformance-only Policy surface?
rationale: The choice changes security enforcement, config precedence, status/doctor diagnostics, and upgrade behavior, and current main has adjacent Policy checks but no canonical immutable overlay contract.

options.title: Implement core immutable overlay
options.body: Define a startup-loaded operator policy source with locked precedence, config-write conflict checks, status/doctor visibility, regression tests, and docs.

options.title: Keep conformance-only
options.body: Document that operators should use policy check, policy compare, external file permissions, or deployment management while runtime config remains the mutable source of truth.

options.title: Defer until hook work settles
options.body: Keep this issue open while related hook proposals establish plugin enforcement context for a narrower later design.

recommendation.title: Implement core immutable overlay
recommendation.body: Define a startup-loaded operator policy source with locked precedence, config-write conflict checks, status/doctor visibility, regression tests, and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the issue and authored the prior implementation candidate, making them the clearest decision owner for the security boundary.
